race.comment: JUNGLE COBRA (1) boasts a strong record this journey here with two wins and two minors from six tries. Missed the frame latest (19.85) when fourth over 342m at this track in a TG1-4W. Looks suited here and rates on top. HARRIS ROAD (4) copped a check in the run finishing out of the placings when a 7 length sixth (20.05) in a TG1-4W at this track. Can measure up this time. POCO SIYAN (8) has been mixing form lately, hitting the frame two back before finishing fourth (23.13) at Murray Bridge in a Grade 6. Well placed here and should do much better.
